clips.send: A parent on antidepressants sends it to their own doctor before the next refill - the Newsweek number, and the fear the pill's side effect is more of the same problem.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau cites a Newsweek headline most people never see: antidepressants outperform a sugar pill only 15% of the time.

His point: if you're depressed, it's not because your brain is deficient in Prozac. And the side-effect list for most antidepressants includes depression itself - the number one most common side effect of the very drug prescribed for it.

His view isn't to stop anything on your own. It's to actually read the side-effect insert before your next refill, and ask your doctor what else could be driving the low mood.

Have you ever read the full side-effect list on your own prescription?

clips.end_words: to get rid of the Candida
clips.send: A parent sends it to whoever just finished a round of antibiotics - why the sugar cravings started right after, and the worry of what's really going on in their gut.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau connects a habit most people brush off - sugar cravings, bloating, gas - back to one root cause: Candida yeast overgrowth.

Antibiotics kill bacteria, which is the point when you're sick. But they don't just kill the bad bacteria - they wipe out good flora in the gut too. Candida, a yeast that's normally kept in check, moves in and overgrows, he says, and it feeds on sugar.

His view: if you crave bread, wine or dairy more than you used to, or deal with gas and bloating, it's worth asking whether gut yeast - not willpower - is driving it.

Have you taken antibiotics in the last year?

#kevintrudeau #guthealth #candida #antibiotics #foodtruth #wbhealth

clips.send: A parent sends it to whoever is stuck inside stressed - a free 15-minute fix, and the relief of something that actually works today.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's free fix for stress, anxiety and a low mood: go for a walk and look at things far away.

Walking gets blood moving and releases endorphins - the body's own feel-good chemicals. His twist: instead of looking down or inward, pick a distant point - a treetop, a bridge, a lamppost two hundred yards off - and walk toward it with your eyes on it the whole way.

His view: it costs nothing, which is exactly why almost nobody talks about it.

What's the farthest thing you can see from your front door right now?

#kevintrudeau #stressrelief #walking #endorphins #naturalhealth #wbhealth
